tagline: Multidisciplinary film and digital content producer with 2+ years experience in video production, directing, and creative content management.
bio:
Film and Television graduate from Indonesian Institute of The Arts Yogyakarta with experience leading video production for YouTube channels (300K+ views), directing short and documentary films, and managing creative content.

Served as Production Manager at Fixinema Media and Production Assistant at WKWK Project by Genflix (2M subscribers). Experienced in writing, directing, producing, graphic design, and festival programming.

pengalaman.deskripsi: A YouTube-based podcast and entertainment channel under Genflix, producing talk shows and creative video content featuring public figures and industry professionals, with a large national audience. Assisted the production team for WKWK Project by Genflix, a YouTube channel with nearly 2 million subscribers. Contributed to the production of 20+ podcast videos, supporting videography, photography, and editing processes. Worked on podcast, in-house content, and inter-company collaboration projects. Served as Prop Master for a Bank Sinarmas campaign video. Handled hundreds of documentation photographs for social events, internal company activities, and ceremonial events.

Creative media production company specializing in film-related content, videography, photography, social media content, and audiovisual production for brands and creative projects. Created and developed a company YouTube channel focused on film and creative industries. Managed end-to-end content production: idea development, content planning, and execution. Produced 30 film podcast videos featuring Indonesian film industry professionals. Created 30+ Instagram carousel posts related to film knowledge and industry insights. Developed dozens of educational film videos. Achieved 300,000 total YouTube views and 3,500 watch hours within one year.

Creative agency focusing on visual communication, graphic design, motion graphics, and digital content production for corporate and commercial needs. Worked in a flexible arrangement (remote and on-site) supporting social media content production for in-house and client companies. Produced 50+ social media contents including stories, vertical videos, and graphic posts, involved from asset preparation to final delivery. Created various content formats such as graphic design and motion graphics. Assisted in photo and video production for client social media content. Utilized industry-standard tools: Adobe Photoshop, Illustrator, After Effects, and Premiere Pro.

Information technology company providing application and software development services, with a dedicated content and creative division supporting digital products and corporate communication. Created 2D graphic designs and 2D motion graphics for company and client social media content. Produced graphic assets using Adobe Photoshop and Adobe Illustrator, and animated motion graphics using Adobe After Effects. Contributed to the production of one 2D motion graphic video for the company profile. Produced 10+ graphic contents in the form of Instagram Reels, posts, and stories. Assisted in developing graphic design materials for the company profile during the internship period.

organisasi.deskripsi: A film appreciation and screening organization at the Faculty of Recorded Media, Indonesian Institute of the Arts (ISI) Yogyakarta, focused on film exhibition, discussion, and audiovisual literacy. Organized regular film screenings held weekly or monthly, featuring one feature film or 3–6 short films per session. Curated short and feature films through internal archives and external scouting processes. Prepared and coordinated post-screening discussion and Q&A sessions. Served as Moderator, facilitating discussions and guiding audience Q&A with speakers and filmmakers.

Sewon Screening is an international campus film festival organized by the Indonesian Institute of the Arts (ISI) Yogyakarta students, focusing on film exhibition, curation, discussion, and audiovisual literacy, held annually for one week. Served as a Film Programmer, responsible for curating 300+ short films through open calls and scouting processes. Selected and developed two international feature film programs for public screenings. Initiated and curated an inclusive film program highlighting diverse perspectives and accessibility. Developed a film archive education program to introduce archival practices and film literacy. Organized and coordinated discussion programs with filmmakers and film professionals on various topics. Collaborated with internal teams to ensure screening schedules, program coherence, and audience engagement.

pendidikan.institusi: Indonesian Institute of The Arts Yogyakarta
pendidikan.detail: Consistently produced short films as semester-end projects. Served as Writer in 3 films, Director in 2 films, and Producer in 1 film. Produced 2 documentary films, one of which, Behind the Sea, received approximately USD 1,000 in funding from the National Research Agency. Created 3 short fiction films, several of which were selected for national-scale screenings. Currently developing one feature-length screenplay as a final project.

Actively involved in a cinema organization producing short films and audiovisual works, with at least one production each semester. Completed formal studies in design, audio-visual production, and basic computer and networking fundamentals.

achievements: Student Award Jury Member - Jogja-Netpac Asian Film Festival 2022
Received approximately USD 1,000 in funding from the National Research Agency for a short film titled Behind the Sea (2024)
Wrote a short film titled Heaven Pass, which was officially screened at a national-level film festival, the Bandung International Student Film Festival (2024)
Film Programmer at Sewon Screening - curated 300+ short films for international campus film festival
